name: Return the Comb
summary: In Darkshire, Madame Eva waits for the comb Blind Mary has returned. Its ghostly strands can be spun into Ghost Hair Thread.

sections.title: A Bitter Reflection
sections.body: Blind Mary waits in a shack south of Darkshire, grieving the death that changed her. Madame Eva’s comb recalls the grooming of her mortal life, and deepens her sorrow. She sees only a wraith, a monster stripped of mortal grace. Certain no one can love her again, she thrusts the comb and the ghostly hair tangled in its teeth back into your hands.

sections.title: Weaving the Supernatural
sections.body: Madame Eva awaits the comb in Darkshire, knowing the work was grim. With the ghostly hair, the fortune teller can spin a spool of Ghost Hair Thread. She pays you for any strands left after the delicate work.

faq.q: Why does Blind Mary react with horror to the comb?
faq.answer: The comb recalls Blind Mary’s mortal life and beauty. Seeing herself as a withered spirit overwhelms her with grief, and she rejects the comb, convinced she has become a monster no one will cherish.

faq.q: What does Madame Eva do with the hair on the comb?
aliases: what does eva do with ghost hair
faq.answer: Madame Eva weaves the hair from the comb into Ghost Hair Thread, a mystical thread used to bind evil spirits and sew life into inanimate objects.
Blind Mary haunts a dilapidated shack south of Darkshire, near Tranquil Gardens Cemetery in Duskwood.
Madame Eva is a human mystic and diviner who lives in Darkshire. She offers fortune readings, cryptic guidance, and magical trinkets and reagents to those facing Duskwood’s dangers.

faq.q: What follows after returning the comb to Madame Eva?
aliases: next quest after return the comb
faq.answer: After taking the comb and preparing the Ghost Hair Thread, Madame Eva asks you to deliver it to Abercrombie, the hermit near Raven Hill Cemetery.

faq.q: Why does Madame Eva give you coins upon completion?
faq.answer: Madame Eva says the comb held more than enough ghostly hair for the spool. She gives you a few coins for the extra strands she keeps.

angles.text: Spinning Ghost Hair Thread shows how Duskwood’s spectral material can be harvested and carded into durable supernatural textiles.
As a priest, you can see how grief torments spirits bound to the mortal world, even when they mean no harm.
As an Alliance traveler, you cross gloomy roads between Darkshire and Mary’s home, where Duskwood’s decay reaches the roads.
